entry.title: Market brief — 26 Nov 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: on 26 Nov 2026 the Nifty 50 closed at 25,884.50 (+65.25, +0.25%) and the Sensex at 84,328.59 (+390.31, +0.46%), a second day of gains led by information technology, realty and metal shares, with the rupee at 92.44 per dollar. IBJA's 12:00 IST benchmark put 24K gold at ₹1,22,982 per 10 g (+₹1,672, +1.38%) and 999 silver at ₹1,46,933 per kg (+₹3,411, +2.38%). The next session is Friday 27 November 2026. Education, not advice.
